Strategic Insights & Red Flags
Immediate leadership priorities

🚨 The Low-AOV Beverage/Dessert Trap

Beverages (1.09x ROAS) and Desserts (1.64x ROAS) consume 23% of total ad spend. Because basket sizes are low (₹140-190), fixed click costs wipe out restaurant contribution margins.

💎 Cart Page: Premium Monetization Lever

Cart Page delivers the marketplace's highest return (5.80x ROAS) with a 22% conversion rate, yet remains 24% unsold. A prime upsell target for high-AOV cuisine partners.

📈 Search Top Hits Capacity Ceiling

Search Top is 90% filled across all days. Additional volume cannot be sold without degrading user search experience. The revenue growth lever here is floor price optimization, not volume.

Churn Vulnerability by Merchant Tier
SMB vs Enterprise Chain retention dynamics

⚠️ SMB Merchants Experience 10x Churn Risk

31% of SMB advertisers churned during the period, compared to only 14% of Mid-tier and 3% of Enterprise Chains. SMB budgets are fragile to initial week performance volatility.

📉 The Month-3 Retention Cliff

Advertiser churn accelerates between Month 3 and Month 6. Onboarding support must proactively audit bids and creative before the Day-90 mark to prevent silent budget depletion.

🛡️ Strategic Recommendation: Automated Floor Shields

Implement algorithmic bid adjustments for first-time SMB campaigns to guarantee minimum ROAS thresholds and prevent early flight abandonment.
